<!-- ==========================================================================
  NCDPI Quarto page template  (design-system Phase 3)
  ==========================================================================
  A starter .qmd for a page INSIDE a Quarto website — this style guide's
  own pattern. Quarto supplies the navbar, sidebar, and typography theme;
  the loader script at the bottom adds the design-system components
  (.ncdpi-*) on top.

  HOW TO USE
  1. Copy this file into your Quarto project and rename it.
  2. If the project is THIS style-guide site: the loader at the bottom just
     works (it finds the site root from Quarto's own asset links, at any
     depth). In a DIFFERENT Quarto project: copy theme/tokens.css +
     theme/ncdpi-ds.css (and theme/fonts/) into that project and keep the
     loader, or replace it with two plain stylesheet links in the YAML
     (include-in-header).
  3. Replace every [bracketed] placeholder; delete what you don't need.
     Normal markdown works everywhere outside the ```{=html} blocks.

  HOUSE RULES
  - Headings state messages, not topics (C2 spirit).
  - Charts: use the site's chart-loader / Vega pipeline where available —
    the chart paints its own title, so a chartframe around it carries only
    __body + __source (chart-titled mode). A static image instead? Use the
    frame-titled chartframe from the one-pager template.
  - Tables: caption leads with the contract; keep scope attributes (C2).
========================================================================== -->

## [What the numbers say, as a claim]

```{=html}
<div class="ncdpi-stat-row">
  <div class="ncdpi-stat">
    <span class="ncdpi-stat__label">[Measure]</span>
    <span class="ncdpi-stat__value">[86.4%]</span>
    <span class="ncdpi-stat__delta ncdpi-stat__delta--good">▲ up [1.2] pts from [2024]</span>
    <span class="ncdpi-stat__source">Source: [source, year].</span>
  </div>
  <div class="ncdpi-stat">
    <span class="ncdpi-stat__label">[Second measure]</span>
    <span class="ncdpi-stat__value">[115]</span>
    <span class="ncdpi-stat__delta">[context, no change]</span>
    <span class="ncdpi-stat__source">Source: [source, year].</span>
  </div>
</div>
```

## [What the chart shows, as a claim]

[In this style-guide site, embed a chart the house way — a `.vl.json` spec
rendered by chart-loader, which paints its own title/subtitle/source. In a
plain Quarto project, drop in a static image or the one-pager template's
frame-titled chartframe.]

## [What the detail table breaks down]

```{=html}
<table class="ncdpi-table">
  <caption>[Measure (unit) by geography, period]</caption>
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th scope="col">[Geography]</th>
      <th scope="col" class="num">[2024]</th>
      <th scope="col" class="num">[2025]</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <th scope="row">[Row name]</th>
      <td class="num">[85.2]</td>
      <td class="num">[86.4]</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
  <tfoot>
    <tr><td colspan="3">Source: [source, year]. [Notes.]</td></tr>
  </tfoot>
</table>
```
